name: admission_appeal_dismissed
description: Sent to the parent when the appeal panel dismisses the appeal.
subject: Outcome of your appeal for {child_name} ({application_ref})
body: The independent appeal panel has considered your appeal for a place for {child_first_name} in Year {year_group} for {academic_year}, and has decided not to uphold it.
The panel's decision is binding. If you would like {child_first_name} to be placed on our waiting list, please let us know and quote your reference {application_ref}.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
